_readme: Quick import template for Memory Match cards. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
word: the English word that is read aloud (required, up to 40 characters).
image: leave it as "" to upload the picture later in the editor, paste a link that starts with https://, or paste SVG code (<svg ...>...</svg>).
SVG code: use single quotes inside the SVG, keep it on one line, under 30,000 characters. SVG is best; PNG, JPG and WebP up to 2 MB can be uploaded in the editor.
audio: optional. Leave it as "" (the word is read by the browser voice) or give an https:// link to a recorded pronunciation.

group: optional, for Sort It. Leave it as "" or leave the key out for no group. A name must already exist under Groups (any capital letters are fine); the seeded groups are food, animals, shapes, school, home and nature unless the parent changed them. The import never creates groups, and an unknown name stops the whole import.
active: true or false (default true). Turn a card off to keep it out of the game.
Cards are added to the end of the list and are unsaved until you press Save. Cards without a picture must be finished by hand before you can save.
